difficultyRule.quote: Первый этап использует простые вопросы и даёт 100 очков за верный ответ, второй — средние вопросы и 200 очков, третий — сложные вопросы и 300 очков.

cards.difficultyAnalysis: Easy: asks readers to recognize the familiar long-track individual format from paired starts, a clock, and lane changes; it does not require rule-number recall.

literal.prompt: В каком формате конькобежцы стартуют парами, соревнуются со временем и меняются дорожками на каждом круге?

fields.sourceAnalysis: The COC overview directly says individual long-track distances are skated in pairs against the clock, with lanes changed once per lap. Short track is described as separate heats with several skaters racing at once; mass start is a pack race and pursuit is a two-team race.
fields.editorialAnalysis: The three cues form one coherent format; only individual long-track distance matches all three. The long-track/short-track distinction is explicit, so the stem does not depend on a hidden terminology distinction.

fields.literal: На индивидуальных дистанциях длинной дорожки спортсмены стартуют парами против секундомера. Смена дорожек помогает уравнять расстояние, которое проходят соперники.
fields.sourceAnalysis: The first sentence is stated by the COC overview. The once-per-lap lane change is directly stated there and is used by the explanation as the reason the pair format equalizes distance.
fields.editorialAnalysis: The explanation summarizes the answer and gives a practical reason; it stays within the cited source and adds no unsupported rule.

fields.literal: Если два конькобежца одновременно подходят к месту пересечения дорожек, преимущество имеет спортсмен во внешней дорожке.
fields.sourceAnalysis: At the crossover point, the COC says the outside-lane skater has right-of-way if both arrive at the same time.
fields.editorialAnalysis: This is a specific and useful long-track crossover fact for the long-track option; it is not offered as a second answer to the format question.

fields.literal: На короткой дорожке спортсмены соревнуются одновременно на меньшем овале.
fields.sourceAnalysis: The COC describes short track on a 111.12 m oval inside an international-sized rink, and says short-track races usually have four skaters at once in the 500 m and 1000 m rounds. This supports the smaller oval and simultaneous-racing claim.
fields.editorialAnalysis: The note explains the short-track distractor with its defining venue and race setup. It is brief and differentiates it from pair time trials.

fields.literal: В масс-старте конькобежцы едут группой по длинному овалу.
fields.sourceAnalysis: The COC states that long-track mass-start competitors are all on the ice at once and the long-track events use a 400 m oval.
fields.editorialAnalysis: This gives the option a useful distinguishing fact: a group race does occur, but on the long oval.

fields.literal: Команды по три человека начинают гонку с противоположных сторон овала.
fields.sourceAnalysis: The COC states that team pursuit teams have three skaters and begin simultaneously on opposite sides of the oval.
fields.editorialAnalysis: This is a concise factual distinction from individual paired starts; the note does not claim that pursuit is a long-track individual distance.

cards.difficultyAnalysis: Easy: identifies a familiar skating discipline from its in-rink short oval and group racing, without requiring event regulations or exact distances.

literal.prompt: В какой дисциплине конькобежцы соревнуются группой на меньшем овале, размеченном внутри катка?

fields.sourceAnalysis: The COC describes short track as a 111.12 m oval marked on an international-sized rink and describes multiple skaters racing together in its individual events. The long-track source distinguishes a different group format, mass start, on a 400 m oval.
fields.editorialAnalysis: The answer is uniquely supported by both venue and pack-racing cues. The mention of group racing does not make mass start ambiguous because the short oval and in-rink marking separate the disciplines.

fields.literal: Шорт-трек проводят на коротком овале внутри международного катка. В масс-старте тоже едут группой, но по стандартной длинной дорожке.
fields.sourceAnalysis: The first sentence follows the COC short-track oval description. The second contrasts mass start, for which the COC says competitors race together on the 400 m long-track oval.
fields.editorialAnalysis: The contrast resolves the strongest distractor and is directly supported by the two official overviews.

fields.literal: На длинной дорожке индивидуальные дистанции проходят парами против секундомера.
fields.sourceAnalysis: The COC says individual long-track events are skated in pairs against the clock.
fields.editorialAnalysis: This is a useful format distinction from the group racing named in the prompt.

fields.literal: Шорт-трек проходит на коротком овале внутри международного ледового катка.
fields.sourceAnalysis: The COC says short track uses a 111.12 m oval marked on an international-sized ice rink.
fields.editorialAnalysis: The added rink-size detail has modest explanatory value beyond the prompt. There is a minor precision issue: the current wording «международного ледового катка» can describe an international venue, while the COC source says an international-sized rink. The exact wording concern is recorded below; runtime remains unchanged pending any new scope.

fields.literal: Масс-старт проходит группой на стандартном 400-метровом овале длинной дорожки.
fields.sourceAnalysis: The COC describes mass start as a long-track event in which all competitors are on the ice at once, with the event run over the 400 m oval.
fields.editorialAnalysis: This adds the event setting and separates group racing in mass start from short track.

fields.literal: В преследовании команды стартуют с противоположных сторон длинного овала.
fields.sourceAnalysis: The COC says the three-skater teams in pursuit start simultaneously from opposite sides of the oval.
fields.editorialAnalysis: This is a distinguishing feature of pursuit, not of individual short-track starts.

newEditorialFindings.exactCurrentLiteral: Шорт-трек проходит на коротком овале внутри международного ледового катка.
newEditorialFindings.rule: Preserve the source claim without changing its dimension into a venue-status claim.
newEditorialFindings.specificDefect: COC wording is “international-sized ice rink”; the Russian phrase can be read as an international venue rather than a rink of international dimensions. This is a minor precision concern, not a key or source-identification failure.
newEditorialFindings.suggestedPreciseWording: Шорт-трек проходит на коротком овале внутри катка международного размера.
